Tribal Revenues and Expenditures
Tribal income data for four years are given in Table II-23 to show Crow tribal revenue and to indicate recent changes in its order of magnitude.
In the fiscal years 1970 and 1973, oil and gas leases and bonuses constituted an important source of tribal income. In 1970, more than half of total revenue was derived from these sources. Other mineral leases and permits made important contributions. Year after year, the bulk of the tribal revenue has come from the use of Crow natural resources. No substantial income is earned from tribally owned businesses. Indeed, the one business owned by the tribe—the Sun Lodge near Crow Agency—operated at a deficit.
